contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VAL[--]PF AVG ; R/ GLO[RIA RO]MANORVM

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece period 19, Lyons mint. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VAL[--]PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive; emperor stands rather than goose steps. Reverse inscription: GLO[RIA RO]MANORVM. In exergue: LVGDPS. Cliff…
